# Class `siteconfig`

The siteconfig class provides functionality for handling site configuration. The class is used by the autotools* class to accelerate the do_configure task.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/classes.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/classes.html#ref-classes-siteconfig)
